scope: Citation context membership, fail-closed responses, signed translation provenance; no semantic/scholarly certification

checks: HTML and four frontend assets served byte-for-byte
Same-origin dynamic config with blank browser API key
Real API rejects unverified history without an external provider call
Second launch reuses the ready instance without a browser

limits: No live Gemini generation or evaluation
No claim-to-source entailment or scholarly validation
Citation-shaped/unbracketed-reference checks are not an exhaustive natural-language fact checker
Missing/empty corpus mappings remain unresolved and are excluded at runtime
Existing confidence heuristics need a separate review
